evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; required growth-stage pressure verification is unavailable.
Exhaust oxygen was 4.8 ppm early in growth.
Exhaust oxygen has risen progressively through 8.4, 13.9 and 16.2 to 21.9 ppm; this raises concern about atmosphere integrity but does not identify a cause.
Temperature 749.8 °C and argon flow 99.9 sccm track setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm; controller reports running.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning tube pressure gauge and growth-stage atmosphere acceptance limits are needed to verify execution; investigate the rising O2 with sensor validation and atmosphere-integrity checks. No sample characterization is available.
